284889919.description:
Natural Agate Geode Specimen
Mounted Mineral Display on Iron Base
Agate, Quartz, Iron, 5.5 Inches
This natural agate geode slice is mounted on a minimalist black iron pedestal stand, highlighting its natural crystallization and banded formations. Geodes form within gas cavities of volcanic rock, where silica-rich groundwater gradually precipitates chalcedony bands and quartz crystals over millions of years. Display pieces mounted on museum-style metal stands are sought after for modern interiors, geological collections, and natural history displays.
Polished front face showcasing concentric agate banding around a druzy quartz cavity
Crystal pocket features sparkling quartz points with dark mineral inclusions
Natural rough reddish-brown matrix rind preserved along the curved back
Mounted on a black finished iron rod and rectangular metal base with rubber foot pads
Measures 5.5 inches high by 3 inches long by 2 inches wide; weighs 1 lb
Condition:
Geological formation is structurally sound with no repaired breaks. Polished face is smooth with natural internal fissures typical of agate. Black iron base shows minor light edge wear and a small paint chip along the front margin. Retains original inventory sticker on the underside.
Thank you for all of your support!
